subject: Re: Interzone availability — spring swap causes demo slot ripple
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@lumenbank.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@lumenbank.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Mar 2026 16:05:00 -0400
Subject: Quick product walkthrough — time check

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the intro earlier. We'd like to lock in a 45-minute walkthrough for our payments team the week of Mar 29 — originally I booked 09:00 CET on Mon Mar 29. Before I send the calendar invite, can you confirm that the time will map correctly for our US and APAC folks? We've seen issues in past years when the US and EU switch DST on different weekends and want to avoid a surprise.

Attendees: Liam, Aisha (PM), and two engineers (will add if we confirm).

Prefer weekdays between 09:00-12:00 CET. If that slot is risky due to DST, please propose alternatives.

Best,
Liam
LumenBank

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@lumenbank.com>
Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@lumenbank.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Mar 2026 18:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Quick product walkthrough — time check

Thanks Liam — good flag. Short answer: yes, the week of Mar 29 is the one where EU moves clocks one week after the US this year, which creates a one-hour offset change for that single week. That has bitten a few cross-region demos in the past.

Options that keep everyone in working hours and avoid the ambiguous hour:
- Mon Mar 29, 09:00 CET (US attendees would join at 04:00 EDT — pretty early)
- Mon Mar 29, 15:00 CET (US 10:00 EDT — safe for US/EU, late for APAC)
- Tue Mar 30, 08:00 CET (US 03:00 EDT — again early)

If you expect APAC participation, we can split into a 30-minute technical sync timed for APAC-friendly hours and a 30-minute product walkthrough for EU/US. Jonas suggested that below.

I'm attaching a provisional calendar invite for Mar 29 at 15:00 CET (redwood-demo-invite-20260329.ics) and our short mutual action plan so we can iterate. If you confirm a slot, I'll send a firm invite and enable recording + dial-in.

Attachments: redwood-demo-invite-20260329.ics (text/ics); mutual-action-plan-LumenBank.pdf (application/pdf)

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@lumenbank.com>, Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@lumenbank.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 09:02:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Quick product walkthrough — time check

On Sat, Mar 21, 2026 at 18:12 Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com> wrote:
> If you expect APAC participation, we can split into a 30-minute technical sync timed for APAC-friendly hours and a 30-minute product walkthrough for EU/US.

Agree with Grace. Practical suggestion:
- 30-min technical session: Mon Mar 29, 23:00 SGT / 16:00 CET (covers APAC engineers and EU overlap)
- 45-min product walkthrough: Tue Mar 30, 09:00 CET / 04:00 EDT (or Mon 15:00 CET if that works)

Splitting reduces the live overlap stress and avoids forcing anyone into the DST-ambiguous hour. If LumenBank prefers a single meeting, I'd push for Mon 15:00 CET — that's the least disruptive for US.

—Jonas
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@lumenbank.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 08:17:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Quick product walkthrough — time check

Thanks — splitting makes sense for us. Our engineers are in Singapore and will struggle with late EU afternoon, so please go ahead with:

- Tech sync (30m): Mon Mar 29, 16:00 CET / 23:00 SGT — engineers will join for deep-dive.
- Product walkthrough (45m): Tue Mar 30, 09:00 CET / Tue 04:00 EDT — PM and product stakeholders will join then.

Can you send two calendar invites and enable recording for the walkthrough? Also include the mutual action plan in the invite so our procurement team can see next steps.

Appreciate the heads-up on DST — we almost had a double-book last year.

Cheers,
Aisha
Product Manager, LumenBank

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@lumenbank.com>, Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@lumenbank.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 09:14:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Quick product walkthrough — time check

Perfect — thanks for the quick decision. I'll do the following now:

1) Send a 30-minute tech sync invite: Mon Mar 29, 16:00 CET / 23:00 SGT (redwood-demo-invite-20260329-tech.ics)
2) Send a 45-minute walkthrough invite: Tue Mar 30, 09:00 CET / Tue 04:00 EDT (redwood-demo-invite-20260330-prod.ics)
3) Attach the mutual action plan to both invites and enable recording for the Tue walkthrough.

Links: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=xyz123 (tech sync), https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=xyz124 (walkthrough)

If anything changes (extra stakeholders or a blackout on Tue morning for your side) reply to this thread and we'll rebook — wanted to get invites out before the EU switch day to avoid confusion.

Thanks — sending invites now.

—Grace
